Statement: I once had to eat my lunch in the school's quiet room because I accidentally broke a chair, and it made me feel like I was in timeout.
I once got a detention for reading a book during lessons and the teacher made me give it to them, but I never got it back.
When I was 11, my mum got me a 'World's Okayest Kid' t-shirt as a joke, and I wore it on a family outing to the zoo.
I once won a prize for most creative homework at primary school for a drawing of our family cat, but I had to return it because it was a school prize, not a 'creative' one
When I was 10, my mum started taking me to watch the Wales rugby team train at the national stadium in Cardiff
I once accidentally sent a love letter to my best friend's pen pal in Australia instead of the girl I liked, and she still lives there now
I knitted a scarf for my brother that ended up being longer than he is tall.
I once tried to make toast in the microwave and set off every smoke alarm in the house.
I got my finger stuck in a bowling ball and had to go to A&E with it still attached.
My grandma used to make me ride the bus alone to school when I was eight, and I got lost in the suburbs for hours one day
I have a pen pal in Japan who I've been writing to on paper since I was ten.
I named my first goldfish Gordon Ramsay because it kept spitting its food out.
I have a friend who thinks I'm the cousin of a famous British musician, but I've never met them and it's completely false.
I once sent a birthday card to my teacher that was meant for my nan, and it said 'love you loads'.
I accidentally reversed my dad's car into a hedge when I was just meant to be sitting in it.
I have a photograph of myself and my family standing in front of a holiday cottage in Cornwall, but I don't remember actually going there.
I've written a letter to my future self every New Year's Day since I was eight.
I once had to do my maths homework with a pencil sharpener that my teacher lent me because mine had broken and I forgot to bring a new one.
I accidentally called my head teacher 'Mum' in front of the whole school assembly.
My grandma used to make me wear a funny hat with a propeller on it to wear on Tuesdays when I was 6 years old.
I hid a chocolate bar in my bedroom to save for later and found it two years afterwards.
I once met a famous chef in a motorway service station and he told me my sandwich was wrong.
I spent a whole week convinced I could talk to pigeons after one followed me home.
I was on the school choir when I was 12 and our teacher made us record an album in a professional studio, but we never released it
My dad used to let me drive his old toy car around the living room when I was 5 years old, and I crashed it into the coffee table.
I can recite the alphabet backwards in under four seconds because I practised it every night for a month.
My teacher told me I was the first person in the school's history to get a 100% on a maths test, but it turned out I just got 90%
I once accidentally booked a school trip to Paris instead of a local history museum and we ended up in the Eiffel Tower at 7 am
I was part of a school project to build a bridge out of popsicle sticks and it ended up being 10 feet long and winning a regional award
My cat once got onto the roof of our house and I had to climb up a ladder in my pyjamas to get it.
I can't whistle at all, but I can click my tongue loud enough to make a dog look round.
I've never seen a single Star Wars film all the way through, even though I own all of them.
I have a collection of over 50 different types of used stamps that I've been collecting since I was 9 years old.
I once called the wrong number and ended up chatting to a lovely old lady for an hour.
I've memorised every capital city in the world because of a bet with my uncle.
I spent a weekend with my grandparents at their caravan in Pembrokeshire when I was seven, and we built a fort in the dunes and it got washed away
I used to help my neighbour with their gardening when I was 11, and we grew prize-winning tomatoes every year
I have a habit of tapping my left foot every time I'm on the bus, and my siblings started calling it 'The Tap Dance'.
I once got a letter from the Queen's office after writing to complain that my corgi drawing wasn't displayed.
I once accidentally dyed all my dad's white shirts pink by washing them with a red sock.
